description: This file defines the Root controller for the Coocook web application, implementing various actions such as index, homepage, dashboard, statistics, about, and internal methods for request handling and redirection. It manages request preprocessing, access control, URL generation, and view rendering logic.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Root
classes.description: Controller class for handling root-level web requests in the Coocook application, extending Coocook::Controller and using Moose for object system.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Handles the base URL, enforces HTTPS redirection unless in debug mode or on localhost:3000, and sets up request context.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Prepares common stash variables such as app name, user info, and user URL.

methods.name: auto
methods.description: Performs pre-processing for each request, including session message setup, access control, URL and asset configuration, and user-specific stash variables.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the root page, displaying recipes of the day or redirecting based on user capabilities.

methods.name: homepage
methods.description: Displays the homepage with recent public recipes and projects.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Displays the user dashboard with personal and other projects.

methods.name: about
methods.description: Displays the about page with the configured title.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Finalizes response rendering, handling permission-based URL adjustments, error handling, security headers, and robots meta tags.

methods.name: _validated_redirect
methods.description: Validates and processes redirect URLs from request parameters, ensuring security.
